thread:
maria: FYI started a quick perf sweep on the 'shadow' FP8 kernel path. Seeing weird regressions on small batches.

jyoti: details? env and flags?

maria: sm90 nodes, Triton 2.x, CUTLASS shadow kernels enabled via -DUSE_SHADOW_FP8=1 and -DARCH_DETECT=auto. Baseline (int8 fallback) avg token latency 6.8ms, with shadow path 7.9ms.

caleb: that's unexpected — shadow should be faster for long seqs. what's batch/seq distribution?

samir: KV cache hit rate low in this workload (~0.22) and avg seq_len=48. Might be prefetch + kernel launch overhead.

maria: attached quick profile snippet:
```
> trace: kern_launch(ms)=0.9, setup(ms)=0.5, fp8_gemm(ms)=2.1, kv_copy(ms)=1.8, total=7.9
> baseline int8: gemm=1.6, kv_copy=1.5, total=6.8
```

jyoti: so GEMM is slower on FP8 for short mats? maybe cutlass kernel uses different tiling causing extra pressure on L2.

caleb: also saw dynamic linker fallback when arch probe sees sm86 but we compile sm90 kernels — resulting in extra relocation cost. Check build flag -DARCH_TARGET=sm90 vs runtime probe.

build-bot: perf-bench summary uploaded: https://internal/bench/1876543210

maria: proposal: add runtime heuristic -> route to shadow FP8 only if (avg_seq_len>=96 && kv_hit_rate>=0.6 && batch_size>=8) else prefer int8/4bit lane. Also short term: add kernel-launch batching (aggregation window 5ms) to amortize overhead.

samir: can repro locally with script: `tools/repro/quant_shadow_repro.sh --seq 48 --kv 0.2 --batch 4`

caleb: I'll look at the arch-prober mismatch. suspect the probe returns 'sm86' on some sm90 machines due to driver quirks; add a fallback strict-match flag `--require-arch-match`.

jyoti: additionally, calibration currently skews FP8 scales when sequence distribution is truncated; we should re-run calibration with tail sequences. If FP8 quantizer overflows it will insert FP32 fallback which costs.

maria: action items: @caleb verify probe + linker path (eta EOD), @jyoti re-run calibration with tail sequences (eta tomorrow), @samir add a microbench to measure launch amortization (eta 2d). I'll implement heuristic toggle and PR a flag.

caleb: ack. will also test -DTRITON_DISABLE_SYNC_KERNELS toggle; saw it reduce latency variance before.

jyoti: added a quick note: when kv copy is heavy, 4-bit kernels show better memory footprint but more quantization noise. Need to track eval MRR.

maria: cool. tagging this thread for later postmortem if regressions persist. :spiral_note_pad:

build-bot: deploy to dogfood cluster scheduled 2:15pm UTC for canary.

samir: ping if you need datasets to repro, I have a small corpus that matches the problem.
